verification_report.summary: The proof is correct relative to the explicitly supplied book dependencies. The CLD-to-classical extract is consistent with the source comparison in Section 1.2. Scalar pluriharmonic descent matches Proposition 7.2(6), with the same definitions and hypotheses, in [Gubler--Rabinoff, arXiv:2506.13548v2](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2506.13548v2#page=35). For the principal proposition, current ascent and linearity give zero currents for both signs; the second gate makes both signs CLD-psh, hence classically psh. Scalar descent gives classical pluriharmonicity on X, and the supplied singular theorem yields local R-PL regularity. When X is pure-dimensional, the supplied R-PL positive-current comparison applies to each sign and gives GJR harmonicity. The corollary correctly takes the contrapositive for each extension and specializes to L=K. Its final sentence concerns the unrestricted converse of the general CLD-psh-to-positive-current implication for locally integrable functions: the continuous obstruction lies in that ambient scope. It does not contradict the separately stated smooth converse. The preliminary scope concern was resolved on this reading. No unresolved critical error or gap remains.
